title: i just found this sun and i’m crying
content: has this happened to anyone else? i feel like i’m going crazy. i have no idea what is going on what this sub is but reading these stories specifically the bathroom i started tearing up and just crying. what is this? i don’t think i’ve experienced this before i don’t even really know what it is but i have never felt like this before in my life. there is something about how people describe the bathrooms that i just can feel i relate to but i can’t remember having any dreams like this.
